rows.title: Will CT legislators raise the gas tax? With tax rates now below the national average, it’s possible

rows.title: PURA overhauls electric rate process, restricts costs utilities can recoup

rows.title: Lamont to leverage $55M in federal aid to assist poor unemployed

rows.title: Child advocacy group calls for major tax shift to close ‘highly unjust’ income, wealth gaps

rows.title: CT residents brace for a lump of coal in their stockings

rows.title: With Lamont bullish on gambling expansion, the odds improve
rows.standfirst: Talks over sports betting and online gaming come in an economic and political environment vastly changed since March.

rows.title: Unions push back against Lamont’s efforts to shrink state workforce
rows.standfirst: Employee unions want to block Gov. Ned Lamont’s efforts to radically shrink the state’s workforce starting in 2022.

rows.title: If COVID-19 makes campus life less attractive, CT universities will pay a stiff price
rows.standfirst: If the coronavirus changes students’ attitudes toward residential life, the state’s public university’s and colleges face severe financial risk.

rows.title: Are Lamont and his fellow Democrats headed for a showdown over tax reform?
